InVideo AI vs VEXI: AI Video or Social Media in One App?
InVideo AI and VEXI, side by side: what each one does and what it costs, from each company's own pages.

InVideo AI is an agentic video editor: you describe the edit in plain words and its AI agents do it on a timeline [1]. Here is how it compares with one app that makes the post and keeps your feed going.

InVideo AI calls itself “the agentic video editor for serious creatives” [1]. You upload footage and describe the edit in plain words, and an AI agent makes the edit on a real multitrack timeline you can take over at any frame [1]. It also turns a script or idea into a shot-by-shot plan, and its Instagram editor makes a first cut from raw footage with the silences gone, captions on and a vertical frame [1][3]. Plans are priced per seat: on its pricing page today, during a Black Friday sale, Starter is $10 a seat a month billed annually (shown against $20) and Plus is $30 a seat a month billed annually (shown against $60) [2].

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.

The difference is scope. InVideo AI is built around making and editing the video itself, on a timeline your team can work on together in real time [1]. VEXI does the whole job. VEXI costs more than InVideo AI: plans are $199, $399 or $599 a month [2]. What you pay for is the work you no longer do.
InVideo AI makes and edits video, and its site also offers image, voice and music generators [1].
VEXI designs the post with your logo, colors, fonts and voice. Tap anything on the design to change it.
Edits your video: cuts, B-roll, music, captions
The Verdict: InVideo AI vs VEXI
Agentic Video Editor • Per Seat • Credits [1][2]
A strong pick for editing your own footage, or generating video, with AI agents on a real multitrack timeline your team can share [1].
One app: you ask, and it writes, designs, edits the video and posts it. Autopilot runs your week ahead.
How much does InVideo AI cost?

InVideo AI prices its plans per seat [2]. On its pricing page today, during a Black Friday sale, Starter is $10 a seat a month billed annually (shown against $20) and Plus is $30 a seat a month billed annually (shown against $60) [2]. Its plan comparison lists Max at $125 a seat a month billed annually [2]. Each plan comes with monthly credits, and its pricing page says unused credits don't roll over to the next month [2].
